excerpts.text: Nature of transport gap and magnetic order in zircon and scheelite type DyCrO4 from first principles. Our first principles density functional theory calculations within GGA + U approximation reveal that the nature of transport gaps in the zircon and scheelite phases of DyCrO(4) are quite different.

Crystal structure of the cubic double-perovskite Sr2Cr0.84Ni0.09Os1.07O6. The crystal structure of the cubic double-perovskite Sr2Cr0.84Ni0.09Os1.07O6, grown at high pressure, was solved using intensity data measured at 113 K.
